Data source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey, 2020; and U.S. Census Bureau, National Intercensal Estimates, 2021

column14: Number on probation per 100,000 adult U.S. residents, December 31, 2020/b

column1: Note: Data quality may vary across jurisdictions for counts of entries and exits. Therefore, the population on December 31, 2020 does not equal the population on January 1, 2020 plus entries, minus exits. Counts may not be actual as reporting agencies may provide estimates on some or all detailed data. Rates are based on the probation population counts as of December 31 of the reporting year and were calculated using U.S. Census Bureau estimates of the U.S. resident population of persons age 18 or older for January 1 of the following year.
a/Reported data will equal estimated data in cases where no imputation was required.
b/Rates were calculated using the estimated adult U.S. resident population in each jurisdiction on January 1, 2021.
c/See Probation: Explanatory notes for 2020 for more details.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey, 2020; and U.S. Census Bureau, National Intercensal Estimates, 2021.
